# Test that issuegraph formula --help surfaces the primitive-discoverability pointers.
#
# Failure of any of these assertions means an agent reading 'issuegraph formula --help'
# would not be told that 'issuegraph formula schema' / 'issuegraph formula primitives' /
# examples/formulas/primitives/ exist. That is the exact failure mode GH#3621
# is closing, so this test is the regression gate.
issuegraph formula --help
stdout 'issuegraph formula schema'
stdout 'issuegraph formula primitives'
stdout 'examples/formulas/primitives/'
stdout 'docs/workflows/formulas.md'

# The list and show subcommands also point at the schema index so agents
# arriving via either subcommand find the primitive surface.
issuegraph formula list --help
stdout 'issuegraph formula schema'

issuegraph formula show --help
stdout 'issuegraph formula schema'
